description: This file defines the AutoEscapeTokenParser class in Twig, responsible for parsing autoescape tags within templates to control content escaping strategies.

classes.name: AutoEscapeTokenParser
classes.description: A parser class in Twig that handles the 'autoescape' tag to enable or disable automatic escaping within templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'autoescape' tag in the template and creates an AutoEscapeNode with the specified escaping strategy.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token marks the end of the 'autoescape' block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this parser, which is 'autoescape'.
